Contract ManageSupplierCRUDService::deleteSupplier(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		matchingSuppliers: Set(Supplier) = Supplier.allInstance()->select(o|o.Id = id),
		existsSupplier: Boolean = if matchingSuppliers.isEmpty() = false 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		Supplier.allInstance()->isUnique(o: Supplier|o.Id)
	postcondition:
		result = existsSupplier
}
